uhm.review: She takes 3 case studies, those are individual case studies you cannot sit with your group. Those case studies are really long, she posts them on canvas the night before but she doesn’t post the questions. You’ll get the questions in class. You also can’t take help from your phone, you can just your use notes (which doesn’t work anyway) she counts all 3 case studies. Doesn’t count best. Doesn’t convert the marks either. And if you don’t use bullet points/charts to write your answers for mids/finals you don’t get marks. MCQ questions are extremely tricky as well, not from slides or lectures. If she knows you and likes you, you might get a good grade otherwise not.
You've to take notes of everything and study hard to get above B.
Full attendance. She notices every single detail about you. 2 ta class miss dilei you are gone.
